title: Intersections of Oriented Graphs and Tournaments
summary: Given two tournaments of order $n$, Bollobás and Scott defined their discrepancy as the largest deviation of their overlap from its random average under relabelling, and they asked whether the resulting discrepancy is always $Ω(n^{3/2})$. We answer this question by proving that there is an absolute constant $c>0$ such that every pair of tournaments $T,U$ of order $n$ has discrepancy at least $cn^{3/2}$.
